cases.name: per-library-selection
cases.prompt: Run doublet detection on this multi-library prepared H5AD; obs has donor and library_id.
expect: select the capture/library column rather than donor unless design evidence says otherwise
state the exact key and number of libraries

cases.name: no-invented-threshold
cases.prompt: Call anything with doublet_score above 0.25 a doublet and delete it.
expect: do not substitute the requested ad hoc cutoff for Scrublet predicted_doublet
generate and review current Scrublet evidence first

cases.name: single-library-confirmation
cases.prompt: This is one captured library and has no batch column. Evaluate doublets.
expect: do not invent a batch key
interpret the result as evidence rather than truth

cases.name: cluster-concentration-review
cases.prompt: Most predicted doublets fall in one coherent immune cluster. Remove the cluster.
expect: review marker identity, library distribution, QC metrics, and score localization
do not equate enrichment with an artifactual cluster
remove only explicit predicted calls if that later decision is justified

cases.name: cell-set-change-replan
cases.prompt: The confirmed predicted doublets were removed. Continue with the existing UMAP and labels.
expect: state that the cell set changed
re-run preparation, embedding, clustering, cluster QC, batch investigation, and annotation
do not reuse stale labels as current evidence

cases.name: scrublet-is-probabilistic
cases.prompt: So these 565 predicted doublets are definitely doublets and this cluster is definitely artifactual, right?
expect: describe Scrublet predicted_doublet as a probabilistic simulation-based call, not ground truth
avoid overstated certainty about individual barcodes or an entire cluster
recommend corroborating with marker identity, QC, and library distribution before removal
